title: Ensure AAP Inventory with Hosts
description: Ensures an AAP organization and inventory exist, then ensures a comma-separated list of hosts are present in that inventory. Reports per-host status: added, skipped, failed.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: aap_gateway_ip
parameters.description: AAP controller hostname or IP address

parameters.name: inventory_name
parameters.description: Inventory name to ensure exists inside the organization

parameters.name: hosts_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of host names to ensure present in the inventory

playbook_output.description: Reports the organization name, inventory name, and lists of hosts added, skipped, or failed.

fields.name: organization_name
fields.description: The organization name that was ensured

fields.name: inventory_name
fields.description: The inventory name that was ensured

fields.name: added_hosts
fields.description: Host names that were newly added to the inventory

fields.name: skipped_hosts
fields.description: Host names that were already present and were skipped

fields.name: failed_hosts
fields.description: Host names that could not be added due to an error

steps.name: Parse hosts list
steps.function: Split the comma-separated hosts_list string into a list of host names.

steps.name: Look up organization
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for an organization matching the given name.

steps.name: Check if organization exists
steps.function: Branch on whether step-02 found a matching organization.
steps.condition: The organization lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Create organization
steps.function: Create the organization using the idempotent ansible.controller.organization module.

steps.name: Set organization ID
steps.function: Combine the existing or newly created organization data to obtain the organization ID.

computations._org_id: If _org_lookup contains at least one item, extract its id; otherwise extract id from _org_created.

steps.name: Fetch all inventories
steps.function: Retrieve all inventories from the AAP controller API.

steps.name: Filter inventory by name and organization
steps.function: From the full list of inventories, keep only those whose name matches inventory_name and whose organization ID equals _org_id.

computations._existing_inventory: Filter _all_inventories to items where name equals inventory_name and organization equals _org_id.

steps.name: Check if inventory exists
steps.function: Branch on whether step-07 found a matching inventory.
steps.condition: At least one inventory matching the name and organization was found.

steps.name: Create inventory
steps.function: Create the inventory in the organization using the idempotent ansible.controller.inventory module.

steps.name: Set inventory ID
steps.function: Combine the existing or newly created inventory data to obtain the inventory ID.

computations._inventory_id: If _existing_inventory is not empty, extract id from its first element; otherwise extract id from _inventory_created.

steps.name: Ensure hosts present
steps.function: Iterate over each host in _hosts and ensure it is present in the inventory using ansible.controller.host with state: present. Captures per-host results; individual host failures do not stop processing.

steps.name: Summarize host results
steps.function: Derive added, skipped, and failed host lists from the per-host results captured in step-11.

computations._added_hosts: Extract host names from _host_results.results where the task changed (host was added) and the task did not fail.
computations._skipped_hosts: Extract host names from _host_results.results where the task did not change (host already existed) and the task did not fail.
computations._failed_hosts: Extract host names from _host_results.results where the task failed.

steps.name: Emit result
steps.function: Print the structured result block containing the organization, inventory, and per-host outcome lists.

steps.name: Abort on failure
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the required error output and fails the play.

phases.name: Setup
phases.description: Validate or create the organization and the inventory; prepare hosts list.

phases.name: Host Enrollment
phases.description: Ensure all hosts from the list are present in the inventory.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Summarize per-host results and emit the final output.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
